source: Elevation ranges (degrees, as the game's readout shows them on flat ground) checked against the readout in recordings: the HUD marks arcs outside them. Barrels match the wiki turret range (data/artillery_weapons.json); mortars count from a resting angle there. Add a weapon once its readout has shown both ends. Weapons not listed take the wiki turret range (mtc_ammo::elevation_limits); guns whose barrel or launcher meets the hull at some headings (2S7, M270, BM-21) are not added from the readout: what it reaches varies with the heading and the ground's tilt.
